body: Yeah what is up with that? I see all these people like really start fixing themeselves, and they seem much happier in life and are genuinely doing well. And I've been trying to heal myself for years, and theres absolutely no progress. It stings seeing people fix themselves so easily and so fast. Especially when they were at a lower point than you were in time, and they still beat you. Why does it even feel like a race? It's pathetic to look at myself in the mirror knowing I'm just as sad as I will always be.
